name: career-pilot-ai-monorepo
description: CareerPilot AI - Monorepo for Frontend (Next.js) and Backend (Node/Express/Prisma)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
